02/13.09.2024  Heard the parties

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 186/2024 arising out of Panki P.S. Case No. 169/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 548/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Bail application of the petitioner was earlier rejected by this Court in B.A. No. 2805 of 2024 vide order dated 02.05.2024.
The petitioner is said to have raped the victim and when confronted, he assured that he will marry her but on the date of marriage, he did not turn up with the barat.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that victim has not supported her case and during the trial she has been declared hostile.
In view of the submissions made above that victim has not supported her case during the trail, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Addl.
